notes: The two separate groups are real for this set and I kept them. The booklet builds the hand truck with its cargo box (b1-b4) as its own small model on page 3, and the aeroplane (b5 onward) separately on pages 4-20. The truck is never attached to the plane; in the last picture it just stands beside it. Joining them would invent a connection the booklet doesn't show.
Minifigure parts (cap, head, torso, legs) are shown in the booklet but are not in the 84-piece parts list, so they are not recorded.

b70 (4861) rests on the studded yellow panels b40/b41. The hinged roof b71 (44571) rests on the studded yellow 1x3 bricks b59/b60 and hinges to the hinge tile b63. Neither rests on the studless tile b62.

The booklet is isometric and several steps are drawn upside-down, so rests_on relations are best-effort. Pieces added in the flipped step 8 (4854, 43719, red wedge plates, 3747b) are recorded as clutching the pieces they attach to, even where they hang underneath.
The second 4855 (Dark Bluish Gray inverted wedge) is not drawn separately; I assumed both are added together in step 3 as the nose underside.
The four cheese slopes (54200) and exact placement of red 1x4 / 1x2 plates in steps 7, 9, 15 and 16 are inferred from piece counts and silhouettes.

Wheels: each of the 3 wheel assemblies is a 3139 tyre on a 3464 wheel centre clipped into a 2415 holder; the nose holder sits under the fuselage and the two main holders sit on the red wedge plates under the wings.
The windscreen (57783) is attached in step 18 and shown again with the roof in step 25; it is recorded once.
The sticker sheet (61980) is recorded once and joined to the tail fin.
Two Dark Bluish Gray tiles on the cabin top: 6636 (1x6) on the left side; 44822 hinge tile plus 3069b (1x2) on the right side.
Propellers are fitted in the final picture (step 25); they are joined to the wing holders (4488) by their axle holes.
